hub.disclosureText: Affiliate Disclosure: We may earn a commission when you shop through our links. Our recommendations stay comparison-led and editorially structured.

method.title: How We Choose Brands
steps: We start with advertiser availability and official site accessibility.
We group brands by real shopper intent, not internal network metrics.
We write useful review notes: best-for, reasons to consider, pros, and watch-outs.
We keep affiliate disclosure visible and avoid misleading discount claims.

faqDefaults.preBuyQuestion: What should I check before buying?
faqDefaults.preBuyAnswer: Check current pricing, regional availability, return terms, and whether the offer applies to your selected product or plan.
